messages.author: Harry
messages.content_text:
In the cold blue glow of candle charts,
Where midnight markets whisper arts,
There walks a man through profit’s rain —
Powell, a name in crypto flame.

From Nordic nights and silver frost,
He learned that every gain has cost.
With steady hands and sharpened sight,
He reads the storms of red and white.

The screens awake before the dawn,
While lesser dreamers still sleep on.
Numbers dance like northern skies,
Reflected deep within his eyes.

He speaks in clips and livestream light,
To restless souls that chase the night.
Some seek fortune, some seek fame,
Some only want to learn the game.

Yet markets turn like winter seas,
No king commands their hidden breeze.
And still he stands through loss and rise,
A quiet fire beneath the skies.

For trading is no golden throne,
No path a person walks alone.
But courage mixed with calm control
Can carve endurance in the soul.

So here’s to charts, to risk, to will,
To learning when the world stands still.
And to the voice through glowing screens
Who chases futures few have seen.
